firm_data.firm_name: The Cook Group Legal Litigation Attorneys
firm_data.firm_description: The Cook Group is a minority & women-owned law firm committed to client service with formidable legal talent across multiple jurisdictions and disciplines. They focus on modernizing and streamlining practices to more efficiently serve their clients while aggressively advancing and protecting their clients’ interests.
notable_facts: The Cook Group is a minority & women-owned law firm.
The firm has offices in New York City, Buffalo, Chicago, Ft. Lauderdale, Los Angeles, Morgantown, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh and St. Louis.

additional_contacts.name: Hanson D. Horn
additional_contacts.title: Trial Attorney, Managing Partner - Fort Lauderdale

email.subject: AI for The Cook Group Legal Litigation Attorneys, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Noah,

The Cook Group's focus on modernizing and streamlining practices across 9 jurisdictions with 60 attorneys is exactly what drew me to reach out. You're clearly thinking ahead about how to compete without losing the agility that makes your firm distinctive.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across multiple jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your NYC office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping litigation teams compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
